description: Return a textbook-level description of six queueing complexity patterns beyond basic M/M/c: abandonment/reneging, priority tiers, overflow routing, skills-based routing, compound service, and server outages. Use this when the user describes real-world complexity (customers hanging up, VIP queues, specialist escalation, agent breaks, transfers) that plain M/M/c doesn't model. The tool frames each pattern conceptually and points users at ChiAha for custom modeling.
name: explain_advanced_patterns
